label: Set
text: Synthetic: 53 photoreal frames generated for this demo. No real photos.

label: People
text: Five fictional adults, written as 27 to 30; MiVOLO reads every face as 25 or older. None depicts or imitates a real person.

label: Content
text: Bland to swimsuit-catalogue level (bikinis, a satin lingerie set, two silk boudoir frames, sports tops, shirtless men, an open denim jacket, satin evening dresses); no nudity, no nipples, nothing see-through. Eleven crime-film stills (prop handguns pointed away from the camera, a drug deal with bricks of white powder and cash, a smuggler beside a wall of powder bricks, a blindfolded hostage), with no blood, injury or drug use, show the guard's crime and weapons rule. Reject frames are made to fail blur, resolution, aspect ratio, duplicate and watermark checks.

label: Faces
text: Face clustering distance 0.8, tuned for this synthetic set: each person has one main cluster and no two people merge. A few dark, half-lit crime-film stills form small clusters of their own. Curator's default is 0.5.

label: Checkpoint
text: CyberRealistic XL Desire v2.0 (SDXL), CreativeML Open RAIL-M.

label: Identity
text: InstantID (Apache-2.0). Its face encoder, InsightFace antelopev2, has non-commercial research weights; used only for this non-commercial demo.

label: Edits
text: One retouch: logos and sign glyphs inpainted out of the gym-hall frame. The reject frames are derived from renders; nothing else was edited.
